rationale: The tape is genuinely two-sided: the stock gapped up 4.2%, holds above rising VWAP, and just printed a new session high on 2.75x relative volume (continuation-long evidence), yet that breakout came on sharply fading volume (31k to 6.4k shares), the last trade hit the bid rather than the ask, and price sits 2.4% extended above VWAP in a risk-off tape (SPY -0.69%, VIXY +3.3%) — valid short-fade evidence. With no news catalyst, no comparable historical setups, and a 22bp spread consuming roughly two-thirds of the $0.06 five-minute ATR, transaction costs plus signal conflict leave no measurable directional edge at the noisiest point of the session, so standing aside is the highest-expectation action.
